title: The Figure That Went Back to the Sleeve

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Offer a figure to a stick and the stick keeps its notch; the figure goes back into the fist and the fist into the sleeve. Neither has paid, and the wood has not learned a name.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the firing women at the Low Kiln wells

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and twenty to four hundred and twenty-two days, six months and two hundred and forty to two hundred and forty-two days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 419 exact at the opening on answer 414, closing at 422 exact on answer 420. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting, and the yard well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Ilmen 26, 27 and 28 are ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes; no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner on any of them, and Ilmen 30 (Day 424), the month's third and last reading and market, stands two mornings beyond the close, a date and not a day earned. The chapter opens in the small hours of Ilmen 26 with the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 414 and the count exact at 419, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, two readings of the year gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind the twelve of Y.H. 813 and two still two and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, six hearings with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, 414 honest answers on the sixth place, the well-asking answered with the weather on its own place beside the second man's narrow slate with its writing turned to the sleeve and his direction down the north bridge road, the fifth shaping on its own tray, the clerk's entered figure on its own place with a finger between it and Tarn's degree and another between it and the face at the yard's edge, Tarn's withheld sentence found where put and not made a habit, Jorra's promise neither given nor withdrawn, the softening at the river's skin kept as weather, the keeping at the fold found where put and the cold foot uncured.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Figure Held Out at the Well
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{420}{Ilmen 26, Y.H. 814, Sixthday}: small hours opening on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 414 and the count exact at 419, then first light, the carrying-down and the morning work at the yard well. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Ilva once at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and the finer rack dust in one thumb seam, her hand going to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, the notched birch strip unread in its fold, her ninth record-first hand nine; Garl Vail in objects only. Walk-ons at the bucket-round, among them the unnamed woman waiting her turn who offers a figure for the month's firings and puts it toward the strip in Ilva's sleeve. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row on stage, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; the clerk stays reported at the landing; the well-asking stays on its own place beside the direction and the turned slate and is not told again; no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eleventh arithmetic or eighth opening and no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing crosses forward from Ilmen 25 as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 30 stands two mornings off, a date and not a day earned. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). Count becomes 420 exact, six months and two hundred and forty days told by nobody, and is not stood up as a threshold, doctrine or figure; the twelve old arithmetics are not laid across the two readings of the year to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer and no key came under any roof (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 held). **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid (T080 with T090/T102):** a woman waiting her turn at the well offers a figure for the month's firings and puts it toward the strip in Ilva's sleeve; Ilva's hand goes flat over the fold before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it — *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — while the offered figure goes from the fist toward the wood, looks at the light and goes back into the sleeve, arriving nowhere. The boy takes the order apart by the place of each part as a surgeon takes a field apart — fist, eye, mouth, the half-beat lying in the gap — and files the offer and its return on a place of its own beside her ninth record-first hand and the fifth shaping of the well-saying, with a finger between every pair: not a sale, not a reader made, not a tenth hand, not a payer, not an account, not a sixth shaping, not the calling of the loan and not joined to the well-asking, the clerk's entered figure, the second man's slate or the face; a reaching gathering interest toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together, and not that hand. Ilva's fear is advanced and left unpaid: the count stays in wood where no clerk's thumb can take a figure off it and she is not made the woman who explains the notches. Sella keeps the whole morning hearth grammar with repair kept apart from restoration; Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel with *he's not Vail* sealed. Answer **415** comes out and is filed on the sixth place: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-sixth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 26 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 416 and the count at 420 exact, six months and two hundred and forty days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine. Walk-ons at the ordinary Sixthday grammar. The offered figure is not offered a second time on a day that earned only its twenty-sixth, the asking is not told again, the direction and the turned slate stay where put, no collector comes up or down the clay road and no sixth of anything stands. Day already dated in Scene 1. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather — pail on stone, the rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure, barley passed wall to wall and never made into a number — and goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, keeping the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). The trough stands bare and dark with the gone pan's shallow round print on a place of its own; at the Vail corner the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw beside the called-gone ridge with a finger between, and the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note runs nearer under the skin — found where put, called weather, not looked twice, not made a sign, a fourth covering or a payment (T083/T085/T092, T009/T013/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a number in a shut fist goes toward the well, looks at the light and returns into a sleeve and arrives nowhere; a woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and no signature stands between the figure and the price (T077). The offered figure and its return are found where put on their own place beside the ninth hand and the fifth shaping, not made a habit, not joined and not spent (T080 advanced, not paid). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree, the face, the first man's face, the second man's slate and direction and the well-asking stay on separate places with a finger between every pair; Tarn's sentence is found where put and not made a habit, Jorra's promise stays ungiven (T080/T090/T102, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031 held). Going of the light: Sella keeps the whole grammar with repair apart from restoration and the widow's mark untouched because no hour is an opening and no eighth came due (T058/T079/T100). Small hours: the towel comes out and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap a gap — six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with both gaps in their own squares, three counts in three places staying three, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the keeping at the fold found where put (T078, T061/T082, T081, T088, T060/T086/T097). Answer **416** filed, exact, complete, worth nothing; the hand goes up the inch toward the river's note, the inch not a reach, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ends and comes straight down flat on the fold.

scenes.title: The Twenty-seventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{421}{Ilmen 27, Y.H. 814, Seventhday}: small hours opening on the hand laid down on answer 416 and the count exact at 420, first light, and the morning work, with answer 417 and the count reaching 421 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-one days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary Seventhday grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine, not made a reader by a figure offered on another day. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no telling at the well, no repetition of the offered figure, the asking or the direction, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 26 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and Ilmen 30 stands three mornings off and is not brought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust gone into old horn past the point where a child would still eat it, fold found where put and still a finding, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097). Count becomes 421 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-one days, told by nobody; he does not stand it up as a threshold and does not lay the twelve old arithmetics or the two readings of the year across one another to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 held). The offered figure is found where put on its own place and is not made a second offer, a custom, a sale, a tenth hand or an account (T080 held, advanced and not paid). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket and keeps the whole morning grammar; the twice-mended pot keeps its hairline showing between staple and wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person; the dressed grain is turned under wool unfigured and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six and the seventh at the lip, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, telling the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* — found where put, not a habit, not a tenth stopping; the ear-sentence stops at the word that would call the loan and the Seed 16 breath stays unspent in an ended term (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, parts dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any master who would call a pot early, and takes his bent finger from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031 held). Answer **417** filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-seventh Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 27 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 418 and the count at 421 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-one days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her count still in wood. Walk-ons at the ordinary Seventhday grammar. The offered figure, the well-asking and the direction are not repeated on a day that earned only its twenty-seventh; no word comes up at the well a second time, no collector comes up or down the road and no sixth of anything stands. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: afternoon small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place; the trough bare and dark with the gone pan's round print on a place of its own, not laid across the loaf's stopping or the ridge; the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw kept beside the called-gone grey with a finger between, a thing left in place not a thing forgiven, and the softening at the river's skin found where put and called weather, not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a payment and not made again (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather: the fist goes toward the well, looks at the light and returns into the sleeve and arrives nowhere; the woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; the dressed grain lies covered and unfigured and no signature stands between the figure and the price (T077). The offered figure and its return stay on their own place beside the ninth hand and the fifth shaping, not joined, not spent, not a witness (T080 held). The clerk's entered figure, Tarn's degree, the face, the first man's face, the second man's slate and direction and the well-asking are kept on separate places with a finger between every pair; the offered figure is not laid across any of them and the loan stays uncalled (T080/T090/T102 held). Going of the light: Sella keeps the whole grammar with the hairline showing, both proverbs to pot and fire, the grain turned under wool, the pot rim two inches beyond reach with its half-beat and no look toward the bed, the nineteen steps at the half-pace, the seven walked-around places once and not twice, the fold righted without a second fold and the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Small hours: the towel comes out and the field is gone over by the place of each thing with every gap a gap; the six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, the three counts in three places stay three, nine hands and nine stoppings stay nine with no tenth, the fire's fifth and Garl's name stand side by side without becoming one (T078, T061/T082, T088, T060/T086/T097). Answer **418** filed, exact, complete, worth nothing; the hand goes up the inch, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go and comes down flat on the fold.

scenes.title: The Twenty-eighth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{422}{Ilmen 28, Y.H. 814, Eighthday}: small hours opening on the hand laid down on answer 418 and the count exact at 421, first light, and the morning work, with answer 419 and the count reaching 422 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-two days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the ordinary Eighthday grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine. No Berr, Hessa sighting, man from Slate Row, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no telling at the well, no repetition of the offered figure or the asking, no sixth shaping, seventh hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening or eleventh arithmetic; no slate opened within reach of the basket. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ilmen 27 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and Ilmen 30 stands two mornings off and is not brought. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — the crust stiff and brown-edged, gone into old horn with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put and still a finding and not a placing, the thread frozen and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). Count becomes 422 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-two days, told by nobody who would have known what a number counted; he does not stand the number up as a threshold or a figure and borrows no payer from the arithmetics gone up the road, for paper is not a payer (T071/T072). The offered figure is found where put on its own place, still a reaching and not a payment (T080 held). Sella keeps the whole morning hearth grammar; the twice-mended pot lifts thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, repair kept apart from restoration; the dressed grain is turned under wool unfigured and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and does not turn his head toward the landing, the degree found where put and not made a habit; the loan stays uncalled (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra keeps the wheel-shed silence, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, with *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031 held). Answer **419** filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment supplying no payer.

scenes.title: What the Twenty-eighth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 28 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 420 and the count at 422 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-two days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at kindling and flagstones with the sentence held where put and the loan uncalled; Jorra at the wheel-shed and cold damper with the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva with her strip in her sleeve, the offered figure gone back into the sleeve and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's slate unread up the road with her eighth hand eighth; Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the two readings of the year inside; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and entered figure reported at the out-of-line landing; the first man's face, the second man's narrow slate with its writing turned to the sleeve and his direction down the north bridge road, and the well-asking answered with the weather on their own places with a finger between every pair; the offered figure and its return on their own place beside Ilva's ninth hand and the fifth shaping; the fifth shaping on its own tray; the softening at the river's skin kept as weather; the green at the pot board and the shape at the market's edge as sightings with no eighth. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar. No second well-telling, no market, no collector, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, sixth shaping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: afternoon small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; the seven walked-around places once and not twice with a look and a wide step and no number, widest at the returning-line place; costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry; through the finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water under its winter skin, softer at one edge where the low note runs nearer under it, found where put and called weather, not a hearing, not a fourth covering, not a seventh and not a payer; four low pulls breathe below the boards with the silence where the fifth should have stood and nobody lifts the floor to supply it. Going of the light: Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, gives the small intake, the hold and the letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; she lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing, gives both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, keeps repair apart from restoration, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed, carries him up the nineteen steps at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, seven openings in seven months being seven and not a rule and no eighth coming due on a day that earned only its twenty-eighth (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092). Small hours: the towel comes out as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called; he goes over the field by the place of each thing and leaves every gap a gap — six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside; the heard bell in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the carried fire's four and a gap under the boards, the boards' four and four and a thumb-width knot, or the two readings behind one unsigned figure beside the twelve, three counts in three places staying three because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood; four rooms keeping the same gap with no Court room a fifth likeness; nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth; the carried fire's four low pulls with its payer unnamed four hundred and twenty-two days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the fire and the man standing side by side without becoming one; the offered figure kept on its own place with a finger between it and the ninth hand and the fifth shaping, not a sale, not a reader, not a tenth hand, not a payer, not an account and not joined to the asking, the clerk's entered figure, the turned slate or the face; the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T078, T061/T082, T081, T088, T080/T090/T102, T060/T086/T097). Answer **420** filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the first and second of the new count, the printed figure, the fifth shaping, the offered figure, the clerk's entered figure, the well-asking, the second man's slate, Tarn's degree, the face at the yard's edge, Jorra's ungiven promise, the withheld sentence, the softening, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the winter skin, the widow's mark nor the keeping at the fold. Six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 415 through 420, two to each of its three days, and not one is a doctrine. Count 422 exact, six months and two hundred and forty-two days told by nobody and not stood up as a threshold; no eighth opening, seventh hearing, sixth shaping, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eleventh arithmetic, signature, payer, witness or reader stood on any of the three days. The surgeon's exactness and the infant's want stand side by side and neither buys the other; under them, louder, the wanting goes on — the crust lifted, the thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle — and gets none of the three. Both are true. The second is louder. Neither wins, and no verdict is looked for; the quarrel is the work and the work goes on in silence. The figure went back into the sleeve and the stick kept its notch; the well gave back the weather; the house went on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into a morning not yet lived and not brought.
